systemicFindings.finding: Acquisition stopped on all 49 obligations because the assignment's group stop rule said egress was refused, not because a probe found it refused. C10's own HEAD probe reached 5 of the 7 official hosts it tested.
systemicFindings.fix: Egress is recorded per exact source. A next-wave worker is given the refused hosts and told not to retry them, and the reachable hosts without a blanket stop.

systemicFindings.finding: Seven branch-identity lanes returned seven different schemas for the same two required filenames: different array keys, different status vocabularies, different field names for the same fact.
systemicFindings.fix: A canonical integration status is generated from the seven returns through explicit per-lane adapters, and the next dispatch states the output schema each lane must emit.
